title: Dan on learning from Alan Dawson after Joe Morello
summary: Dan says Morello was inspiring but Alan Dawson could explain and taught him a great deal quickly.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: And me as a drummer I was very lucky because Joe was very inspiring you know, it was like oh man I’d love to be able to play like that. But when Alan came along there was someone that could really explain what he was doing. He was just unbelievably brilliant at saying, well tearing things apart and saying, “Well if you want to do that you have to, you know.” I learned so much from him, it was crazy you know. Just very quickly, like within a short span of time he just taught me what I hadn’t learned all my life it felt like.
